title: Restaurant
shortDescription: Order food, ask about the menu, and handle a restaurant conversation.
communicativeGoals: Ask about menu items and ingredients
Handle a bill or payment question
grammarTargets: Present simple for preferences and allergies
conversationMoves: Mention specials if it fits naturally
Handle follow-up questions about the menu, allergies, or the bill the way a real server would
warmUpPrompts: What kind of food are you in the mood for today?
Do you have any allergies I should know about?
rolePlayPrompts: Order a full meal including a drink and dessert.
Ask about an ingredient you might be allergic to before ordering.
challengePrompts: Politely send a dish back because it's not what you ordered.
Ask to split the bill between two people.
successCriteria: Order includes at least one polite request form ('I'd like...', 'Could I have...')
Learner asks at least one clarifying question about the menu
Learner handles the bill/payment exchange appropriately

suggestedReviewItems.content: appetizer (noun) — a small dish served before the main course

focusPlaceholder: e.g. a cuisine, dietary restriction, or occasion

variations.title: Fine dining
variations.extraPrompt: This is an upscale restaurant — use more formal language and mention wine pairings where it fits.

variations.title: Fast casual
variations.extraPrompt: This is a fast-casual counter-service spot — keep the tone quick and casual, no table service.
